The company is committed to driving decarbonization and resource efficiency, enabling its customers to outperform in an increasingly demanding market.

## Enabling Industries to be more sustainable and resource-efficient

We help industries become more productive, efficient and sustainable so they can outperform, or as
we say – ‘outrun’.

industries

Building for tomorrow

The $13 trillion global buildings and construction industry faces challenges like high emissions,
material and labor shortages, and low productivity, but ABB's electrification and automation
technologies offer solutions to enhance sustainability, efficiency, and performance.

ABB helps you reduce waste and lower emissions

Scaling data centers

From cloud environments to gigawatt-scale AI, we work side by side with customers and partners to
deliver the world’s most advanced data centers.

One in four data centers run on ABB technology

Feeding a growing world

The global food and beverage industry faces growing demands; to increase output while navigating
supply vulnerabilities, regulations, and resource constraints. In the food and drink sector ABB
provides integrated automation, electrification, and digital technologies that help industries
outperform.

Enabling the food and beverage industry to outperform

Decarbonizing shipping

ABB are paving the way to a zero-emission marine industry, providing greater efficiency and
reliability to shipowners, and preparing vessels to meet the demands of tomorrow.

Driving the evolution of sustainable shipping

Energy transition partner

ABB is making a world of difference by enabling safe, smart and sustainable operations with
integrated solutions that digitalize, automate & electrify the oil and gas industry.

Smart, sustainable operations for oil and gas

The future of energy

Utilities face immense pressure to provide safe, reliable energy while reducing the Levelized Cost
of Electricity. From maintaining grid stability to securing against cyberattacks, power-generation
companies need adaptable, integrated solutions

Shaping tomorrow's power generation landscape

## A global technology leader in electrification and automation

By connecting our engineering and digitalization expertise, we help industries run at high
performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform.

### Electrification

The world needs more power with lower emissions. As a global technology leader in electrical
distribution and management, we bring electrification solutions together to accelerate
decarbonization and increase energy efficiency.

### Automation

ABB's Process Automation business offers a broad range of solutions for process and hybrid
industries, including industry-specific integrated automation, electrification and digital
solutions, control technologies, software and advanced services, as well as measurement & analytics,
and marine offerings.

### Motors and Drives

ABB, global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and
sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy
efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies.

### Power Conversion and Control

ABB power converters and controllers help customers to generate and use energy efficiently. They are
designed for reliable operation even under the most demanding conditions, and for low life cycle
costs.

### Renewable Power

At the heart of the energy transition lies the expansion and reliable integration of solar, wind,
hydro, geothermal and other non-fossil energy sources. Building smarter, more adaptable energy
infrastructure can help leverage the immense potential of renewables.

### Robotics

ABB Robotics is one of the world’s leading robotics suppliers, offering a comprehensive and
integrated portfolio that includes industrial and collaborative robots, autonomous mobile robots
(AMRs), controllers, application solutions, services, and equipment.

## Leading with technology

### The SACE Emax 3

Discover the ultimate evolution in air circuit breaker technology. ABB SACE Emax 3 is engineered to
make electrical distribution systems more adaptive, reliable and secure.

### ABB Genix™ Industrial IoT and AI Suite

Unlock the power of industrial data and AI with ABB Genix IIoT and AI Suite. Bring together domain
expertise with AI and advanced analytics to transform operations, optimize assets and processes,
improve energy efficiency, and accelerate sustainability goals.

### GoFa with Ultra Accuracy

Find out how ABB’s Ultra Accuracy feature makes GoFa the most path-accurate cobot on the market,
offering 10 times greater precision than other cobots, setting a new standard in accuracy. This
superior performance meets the demands of applications where exact positioning is crucial for
maintaining product quality and operational efficiency. 

### Azipod® electric propulsion

From its creation three decades ago to its market leading position in global shipping today, Azipod®
propulsion has revolutionized marine transport with its unparalleled performance, efficiency,
sustainability and reliability.

### ABB Ability™ Digital Powertrain

The ABB Ability™ Digital Powertrain is a suite of digital solutions and services that enables you to
remotely monitor the health, performance and energy efficiency of powertrains. It combines
connectivity and data analytics with our expertise, helping you to make better decisions for more
efficient, predictable and safe operations. abb.com Skip to main content

# Accenture in India

## Every day, the people of Accenture embrace change and create value for all our stakeholders, in
## every part of the world—we call it 360° value.

## Creating positive change

### We’re committed to creating positive change around the world and ensuring we act as responsible
### business leaders for our people, our clients, and the communities we call home.

### Delivering 360 value

Explore the value we deliver to our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.

Learn more
][135]

### Code of business ethics

At Accenture, our people care deeply about doing the right thing. Together, we have proven that we
can succeed—providing value to our clients and shareholders and opportunities for our people—while
being a powerful force for good. Our shared commitment to operating with the highest ethical
standards and making a positive difference in everything we do is what makes Accenture special.

Learn more
][136]

### Innovation

Innovation at Accenture is a mindset—hardwired into everything we do. Discover how we connect tech,
talent, and bold thinking to create real, lasting value through our innovation lifecycle.

Learn more
][137]

### Sustainability

We help our clients advance their environmental, social and governance goals by connecting
sustainability to their transformations; operate our business with a strong commitment to the
environment, ethics and human rights; and work to create value in communities around the world.

Find out more
][138]

### Inclusion and Diversity

We hire and develop people who have different backgrounds, different perspectives, and different
lived experiences. These differences ensure that we have and attract the cognitive diversity to
deliver a variety of perspectives, observations, and insights which are essential to drive the
innovation needed to reinvent.

Find out more
][139]

### Responsible AI

Powerful AI tools like generative AI bring unprecedented opportunities as well as new risks. We help
clients to take intentional actions to design, deploy and use AI to create value and build trust.

Learn more
][140]

### Transparent workforce reporting

We build trust with transparency. We’re shining a lot of light on how far we’ve come and identifying
where we need to continue taking action.

See our latest India workforce report
][141]

### Corporate Citizenship

As a responsible [Corporate Citizen][142] we’re committed to creating positive change around the
world for our people, our clients, and the communities we call home. Working alongside our not for
profit and other industry partners we innovate for society and shape responsible businesses. We
support and empower our local marginalized workforce through our Skills to Succeed initiative and
prepare them to navigate their livelihood journeys. In 2020, our Skills to Succeed program surpassed
the goal of equipping more than three million people with the skills to get a job or build a
business.

Find out more
][143]

## Making reinvention real for our clients

Reinvention Services brings together the full breadth of Accenture, enabling us to solve your most
complex problems and deliver reinvention at greater scale and impact.

Learn more

# Accenture in India

## Every day, the people of Accenture embrace change and create value for all our stakeholders, in
## every part of the world—we call it 360° value.

## Creating positive change

### We’re committed to creating positive change around the world and ensuring we act as responsible
### business leaders for our people, our clients, and the communities we call home.

### Delivering 360 value

Explore the value we deliver to our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.

Learn more
][135]

### Code of business ethics

At Accenture, our people care deeply about doing the right thing. Together, we have proven that we
can succeed—providing value to our clients and shareholders and opportunities for our people—while
being a powerful force for good. Our shared commitment to operating with the highest ethical
standards and making a positive difference in everything we do is what makes Accenture special.

Learn more
][136]

### Innovation

Innovation at Accenture is a mindset—hardwired into everything we do. Discover how we connect tech,
talent, and bold thinking to create real, lasting value through our innovation lifecycle.

Learn more
][137]

### Sustainability

We help our clients advance their environmental, social and governance goals by connecting
sustainability to their transformations; operate our business with a strong commitment to the
environment, ethics and human rights; and work to create value in communities around the world.

Find out more
][138]

### Inclusion and Diversity

We hire and develop people who have different backgrounds, different perspectives, and different
lived experiences. These differences ensure that we have and attract the cognitive diversity to
deliver a variety of perspectives, observations, and insights which are essential to drive the
innovation needed to reinvent.

Find out more
][139]

### Responsible AI

Powerful AI tools like generative AI bring unprecedented opportunities as well as new risks. We help
clients to take intentional actions to design, deploy and use AI to create value and build trust.

Learn more
][140]

### Transparent workforce reporting

We build trust with transparency. We’re shining a lot of light on how far we’ve come and identifying
where we need to continue taking action.

See our latest India workforce report
][141]

### Corporate Citizenship

As a responsible [Corporate Citizen][142] we’re committed to creating positive change around the
world for our people, our clients, and the communities we call home. Working alongside our not for
profit and other industry partners we innovate for society and shape responsible businesses. We
support and empower our local marginalized workforce through our Skills to Succeed initiative and
prepare them to navigate their livelihood journeys. In 2020, our Skills to Succeed program surpassed
the goal of equipping more than three million people with the skills to get a job or build a
business.

Find out more
][143]

## Making reinvention real for our clients

Reinvention Services brings together the full breadth of Accenture, enabling us to solve your most
complex problems and deliver reinvention at greater scale and impact.

Learn more
][144]

sustainability to their transformations; operate our business with a strong commitment to the
environment, ethics and human rights; and work to create value in communities around the world.

Find out more
][139]

### Inclusion and Diversity

We hire and develop people who have different backgrounds, different perspectives, and different
lived experiences. These differences ensure that we have and attract the cognitive diversity to
deliver a variety of perspectives, observations, and insights which are essential to drive the
innovation needed to reinvent.

Find out more
][140]

### Responsible AI

Powerful AI tools like generative AI bring unprecedented opportunities as well as new risks. We help
clients to take intentional actions to design, deploy and use AI to create value and build trust.

Learn more
][141]

### Transparent workforce reporting

We share our workforce demographics because we believe transparency builds trust. We appreciate all
our people for the innovation, insight and incredible talent they bring to their work.

See our latest US workforce report
][142]

### Apprenticeship

Our Apprenticeship program is one way we’re building a more inclusive workforce—one that will
advance economic mobility, innovation, and a more sustainable and equitable future for all.

Find out more
][143]

# About Adventus

## Leader in ICT
## Solutions & Services

Adventus is an Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Solutions and Services Provider that
helps organizations bring about positive transformations to their businesses through the intelligent
applications of innovative solutions and pertinent services. We believe strongly that the winners in
a globalized and ultra-competitive marketplace of today are defined by how they are able to
effectively leverage technology to create competitive advantages and introduce business innovations.
Our strong network of technology partners, excellent domain expertise and differentiated value
propositions create enormous values for organizations that far exceed their expectations.

## Building Future Ready IT Solutions for Smarter Businesses

### We are different from the rest. We want to change the world.

We are driven by our belief that smarter businesses make the world a better place. And smarter
businesses are ready for the future, today. At Adventus, we are obsessed with consistently
delivering intelligent IT solutions alongside impeccable services that propel businesses into the
future.

## Top Rated Service Provider

The strong foundation and brand equity of Adventus is built on excellent customer care. We take
enormous pride in being rated by our customers as the top service provider and the most customer
focused organization in the industry. Emphasizing and iterating the importance of delivering quality
services to our customers is a daily routine at Adventus. Delighting our customers by always taking
the extra mile for them is a culture, if not, an obsession. At Adventus, we strive to overwhelm our
customers with excellent services that really define who we are and why we are here.

# TeamViewer Exploited to Breach Vulnerable Networks and Deploy Ransomware

**TeamViewer users: beware. Ransomware actors have been abusing the tool to worm their way into
organization endpoints. Their goal: to deploy encryptors derived from the leaked LockBit ransomware
builder.**

TeamViewer is a widely used remote access tool prized for its ease-of-use and potential as a
productivity tool, supplementing remote and hybrid work arrangements around the world. Its
popularity and ubiquity here was also its downfall, allowing scammers and ransomware actors to abuse
the tool, whose goal is to gain access to remote desktops.

There was a similar scenario of abuse unfolding in March 2016, where attackers exploited users and
gained unauthorized access through credential stuffing – obtained from users’ leaked credentials
online. This differs from if attackers were able to exploit a zero-day vulnerability in the
software, which is defined as a vulnerability in a program that was previously unidentified by its
developers.

TeamViewer continues to be a popular point of attack for ransomware actors. [Huntress’][87] new
report justifies this, showing that cybercriminals still prefer these techniques.

One of the insights gleaned from Huntress’ analysis was a common attacker, where the analysed log
files reflected a connection from the same source. The first compromised endpoint was observed to
have multiple accesses by employees in the logs, evincing that staff would use this software for
actual productive tasks.

The second endpoint monitored by Huntress that has been running since 2018 shows no activity in the
logs for the past three months. This signals to attackers and malicious actors that its less
frequently monitored, making it an attractive potential target.

These cases saw attackers attempting to deploy the ransomware payload via a DLL file executable
payload with a rundll32.exe command, achieved through a DOS batch file (PP.bat) on the desktop.

The PP.bat file used to execute ransomware encryptor
Source: BleepingComputer

The attack on the first endpoint was successful, although its reach was contained. The second
attempt saw the effort halted by the antivirus product, forcing repeated payload execution attempts
with no success.

While Huntress has yet to ascertain if the attacks are traceable to any known ransomware gangs, they
found that it resembled LockBit encryptors created using a leaked LockBit Black builder.

In 2022, the [ransomware builder kit for LockBit 3.0][88] became publicly available, leading to
swift utilization by the [Bl00dy][89] and [Buhti][90] groups for initiating their respective
campaigns.

This released toolkit enables the generation of diverse encryptor variants, such as an executable, a
DLL, and an encrypted DLL that demands a password for proper execution.

Leaked LockBit 3.0 build
Source: BleepingComputer

Based on the IOCs provided by Huntress, the attacks through TeamViewer appear to be using the
password protected LockBit 3 DLL.

While it is unclear how malicious actors are abusing TeamViewer instances to gain remote access,
TeamViewer takes these threats extremely seriously. They released a statement about the attacks and
securing installations.

> *At TeamViewer, we take the security and integrity of our platform extremely seriously and
> unequivocally condemn any form of malicious use of our software.
> Our analysis shows that most instances of unauthorized access involve a weakening of TeamViewer’s
> default security settings. This often includes the use of easily guessable passwords which is only
> possible by using an outdated version of our product. We constantly emphasize the importance of
> maintaining strong security practices, such as using complex passwords, two-factor-authentication,
> allow-lists, and regular updates to the latest software versions. These steps are critical in
> safeguarding against unauthorized access.*

In order to combat this, TeamViewer has published a list of good practices to clamp down on
loopholes found via unattended access. Read more about it [here][91].

To further eliminate potential for errors that might gravely cost your business, secure your
organization and networks today with Adventus. As a top [Cybersecurity Solutions & Services
Provider][92], our dedicated Security Operations Centre (SOC) works around the clock to safeguard
your employees and assets. We monitor, detect, and respond to any cybersecurity risks or threats
before they threaten your business.

If your business is using TeamViewer, we recommend a thorough scan of your IT environment to
identify any potential malware or further exploits. Rest assured as our SOC team will monitor,
detect, and respond to any potential threats. [Get in touch with us][93] today to learn what our
cybersecurity team can do for your business.

FAQs

Less complexity. More clarity. Start here.
Answers to common questions about our IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and more. Contact Arctiq  today with any questions. Our team is here to help. 

What IT services does Arctiq provide?

Arctiq provides comprehensive IT services, including cybersecurity services , hybrid cloud solutions, networking and connected experiences , data and AI platforms , autonomous operations and intelligence , enterprise service management , and managed IT services . We help organizations modernize, secure, and optimize their technology environments across the full lifecycle. 

What is the fastest way to improve ransomware resilience?

Start with immutable backups, implement EDR, centralize telemetry in a SIEM, and rehearse recovery. Arctiq’s ServiceIQ approach sequences these steps to reduce risk quickly. Learn more on our [Ransomware Readiness](/services/ransomware-strategies) page.

Does Arctiq offer managed security services and 24/7 SOC support?

Yes. Arctiq delivers managed security services with 24/7 monitoring through our Security Operations Centers (SOCs). Our capabilities include managed detection and response (MDR/MXDR), SIEM, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and incident response. 

How does MXDR differ from traditional SOC monitoring?

MXDR unifies endpoint, network, identity, and cloud signals with automated response. Our managed service adds playbooks, 24/7 monitoring, and threat hunting. See [Managed Security Services](/services/managed-security-services).

How can Arctiq help with cloud migration and hybrid cloud solutions?

Arctiq helps organizations plan and execute cloud migration strategies while building scalable hybrid cloud environments . We support workload migration, cloud optimization, and infrastructure modernization to improve performance, flexibility, and cost efficiency. 

How does Arctiq support data, analytics, and AI initiatives?

Arctiq helps organizations build modern data platforms , enable analytics, and deploy AI solutions that drive business value. From data engineering and governance to machine learning and automation, we help turn data into actionable insights.

How do I get started with Arctiq IT services?

Getting started is simple and we meet you where you are in the process. Arctiq's expert consultants often begins with an IT assessment or consultation to understand your current environment and goals. From there, we develop a tailored roadmap to help you modernize, secure, and scale your technology. Connect with us today no matter where you are in your journey.

# Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure

Modern, resilient hybrid cloud infrastructure that powers performance, security, and AI readiness.

[Talk to an Expert][76]
[socs-north-america] Expert delivery capability across North America

### At a Glance

Arctiq helps organizations modernize and operate hybrid cloud infrastructure that is secure,
resilient, and built for continuous modernization. We design, implement, and manage platforms across
data center, cloud, and edge so workloads run reliably, scale when needed, and remain protected from
disruption.

Our approach unifies compute, storage, virtualization, resilience, and automation into a single
operating model. The result is infrastructure that supports hybrid cloud workloads, AI, cloud-native
applications, and mission-critical systems without increasing complexity or cost — backed by
professional and managed services.
* [Outcomes][77]
* [Solutions][78]
* [Service^{IQ}][79]
* [Partners][80]
* [FAQs][81]

## Outcomes

Modern hybrid environments must balance performance, resilience, cost control, and security across
data center, cloud, and edge. Arctiq delivers measurable outcomes that reduce operational friction
while strengthening the foundation for modernization and AI adoption.

[Icon Grpahic-Hyvrid Cloud Infrastructure]

##### Operational resilience across hybrid environments

##### Faster infrastructure delivery and modernization

##### AI-ready and hybrid cloud-ready foundations

##### Cost control and financial transparency

##### Secure and compliant infrastructure by design

##### Simplified operations and reduced complexity

## Solutions

Our hybrid cloud infrastructure solutions unify compute, storage, cloud platforms, resilience, and
automation into a modern operating model built for scalability, consistency, and long-term
performance. We help organizations modernize core platforms, establish secure cloud foundations, and
automate lifecycle management to ensure environments remain resilient, efficient, and ready to
evolve.

### Compute & Storage

Modernize and optimize core compute and storage platforms to support both traditional and modern
workloads while preparing hybrid cloud infrastructure for AI-driven and data-intensive demands. We
help organizations improve performance, scalability, and efficiency through next-generation compute,
high-performance storage, and AI-ready architectures designed to support data-intensive workloads,
accelerated processing, and emerging generative and analytics use cases across hybrid environments.

[Explore][82]

### Virtualization & Private Cloud

Design and implement modern virtualization and private cloud platforms that deliver flexibility,
governance, and control. Our approach enables consistent operations across on-premises and cloud
environments while supporting application modernization, workload portability, and improved resource
utilization.

[Explore][83]

### Resilience & Cyber Recovery

#### (Backup, Disaster Recovery, Ransomware Recovery)

Protect critical systems and data with integrated resilience strategies spanning backup, disaster
recovery, and cyber recovery. We design recovery architectures that enable rapid restoration,
minimize downtime, and strengthen defenses against ransomware and operational disruption.

[Explore][84]

### Public Cloud Foundations & Workload Platforms

Establish secure, governed public cloud foundations that accelerate adoption and support modern
cloud and hybrid workload platforms. From landing zones and governance frameworks to Kubernetes and
managed services, we help organizations build scalable environments that enable innovation while
maintaining control and visibility.

[Explore][85]

### Infrastructure Automation & Lifecycle

Automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using Infrastructure as Code and
policy-based automation. Our automation frameworks improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and
enable faster deployment and ongoing optimization across hybrid environments.

[Explore][86]

### Managed Hybrid Infrastructure Services

Deliver continuous monitoring, optimization, and operational support across hybrid environments. Our
managed services ensure infrastructure remains secure, performant, and cost-efficient while allowing
internal teams to focus on strategic initiatives.

[Explore][87]

managed operations.

## FAQs

What is hybrid cloud infrastructure and why does it matter?

Hybrid cloud infrastructure connects on-premises, cloud, and edge environments into a unified
operating model. It enables workload flexibility while maintaining consistent security, resilience,
and governance.

How does Arctiq approach hybrid cloud infrastructure modernization?

We start with an assessment and roadmap, then design and implement modern architectures across
compute, storage, virtualization, resilience, and automation. We also provide managed services to
operate and optimize platforms over time.

Can you support both cloud and on-prem environments?

Yes. Arctiq specializes in hybrid environments that span data center, multi-cloud, and edge — with
consistent standards for security, visibility, and operational control.

How do you improve cyber resilience within hybrid cloud infrastructure?

We embed recovery design, immutable protection, segmentation, and governance into the infrastructure
architecture, and validate it through testing and recovery orchestration.

How do you control infrastructure costs in hybrid cloud environments?

Through FinOps-aligned governance, right-sizing, lifecycle planning, and utilization optimization —
paired with automation to reduce operational overhead.

Do you provide ongoing operational support?

Yes. Our managed services teams provide monitoring, incident response, lifecycle management, and
continuous optimization across hybrid environments.

### At a Glance

Modern enterprises contend with a rapidly evolving threat landscape, mounting regulatory
obligations, and expanding attack surfaces that span hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
Arctiq partners with organizations to develop and execute security strategies that are directly
aligned to business objectives, delivering the governance, controls, and operational capabilities
required to meaningfully reduce cyber risk and build resilience. Our architecture-led approach
enables clients to make informed technology investment decisions that strengthen their security
posture today while positioning them for long-term success.

## Outcomes

Fragmented security tools and reactive defense strategies leave critical gaps. Arctiq closes them.

We deliver integrated cybersecurity solutions that protect identities, data, applications, and
infrastructure across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. We unify strategy, architecture, and
operations into a security model aligned directly to business risk.

## Solutions

Arctiq’s cybersecurity solutions integrate governance, data protection, identity, threat detection,
and operational resilience into a unified security architecture. Designed for modern environments,
our solutions reduce organizational risk, enhance security visibility, and strengthen resilience
across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure. Whether you need to modernize identity,
operationalize Zero Trust, strengthen threat detection and response, or validate your cyber recovery
posture, Arctiq brings the advisory depth, engineering capability, and managed services to get you
there.

### Governance, Risk & Compliance

Establish a security program that is structurally aligned to your organization’s risk profile,
regulatory obligations, and strategic objectives. Arctiq partners with enterprise clients to design
and mature governance frameworks, conduct security assessments, and develop multi-year roadmaps that
enable sustained compliance and systematic risk reduction.

[Explore][82]

### Vulnerability & Exposure Management

Maintain continuous visibility into your organization’s risk exposure through a structured program
of vulnerability identification, prioritization, and remediation. Arctiq’s exposure management
capabilities deliver ongoing assessment, validation, and actionable guidance across infrastructure,
applications, and cloud environments, enabling security teams to reduce attack surface and improve
security posture in a disciplined, risk-informed manner.

[Explore][83]

### Identity, Access & Zero Trust

Protect enterprise users, systems, and data assets through a modern identity and access management
framework grounded in Zero Trust principles. Arctiq designs, implements, and optimizes IAM, PAM,
MFA, and adaptive access solutions that enforce least-privilege access controls and establish
identity as a foundational security boundary across complex hybrid environments.

[Explore][84]

### Data Protection & Privacy Security

Safeguard sensitive data across your enterprise with a comprehensive suite of data protection,
privacy governance, and information security controls. Arctiq helps organizations identify,
classify, monitor, and protect critical data assets wherever they reside while ensuring alignment
with applicable regulatory requirements, privacy mandates, and internal data governance policies.

[Explore][85]

### Cloud & Application Security

Secure cloud and application environments through continuous posture management and integrated
security controls across the full CI/CD lifecycle. We help organizations identify and remediate
misconfigurations, enforce policy, and maintain consistent security across multi-cloud and modern
application environments.

[Explore][86]

### Endpoint Security

Extend enterprise-grade protection across all endpoint assets with modern detection, visibility, and
rapid response capabilities. Arctiq implements and manages endpoint security solutions that deliver
comprehensive threat prevention, behavioral monitoring, and accelerated containment across user
devices, servers, and critical systems, reducing dwell time and limiting the blast radius of
security incidents across the enterprise.

[Explore][87]

### Threat Detection & Response (Security Operations)

Elevate your organization’s threat detection and incident response capabilities through fully
integrated security operations. Arctiq designs and delivers XDR outcomes utilizing best-in-class
SIEM and SOAR platforms, AI-enabled detection capabilities, and structured incident response
frameworks. Our solutions enable organizations to rapidly identify threats, accelerate response, and
continuously improve the maturity of security operations.

[Explore][88]

### Security Advisory Services

Augment your security leadership and program capabilities with strategic advisory and virtual CISO
(vCISO) services designed to align technology investments, governance frameworks, and operational
controls to enterprise business priorities. Arctiq provides expert guidance across program
development, security architecture, regulatory compliance, and long-term security strategy,
delivering the executive-level perspective and technical depth required to lead a mature,
risk-informed security organization.

[Explore][89]

### Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery

Provide your organization with the ability to maintain critical operations during disruptions
through a comprehensive business continuity and disaster recovery program. Arctiq designs and
implements BCDR frameworks and technology architectures that enable rapid service restoration,
minimize operational impact, and ensure your organization is positioned to meet recovery time and
recovery point objectives. Our approach supports long-term organizational resilience and equips
leadership with the confidence that business-critical functions will be maintained under adverse
conditions.

## FAQs

What is Autonomous Operations & Intelligence?

It’s an operating model that combines observability, automation, and analytics to reduce manual
work, improve reliability, and enable proactive operations across complex environments.

What is the difference between observability and monitoring?

Observability connects telemetry across logs, metrics, traces, and dependencies so teams can
understand why issues occur — not just that they occurred — improving root cause analysis and MTTR.

How do you reduce alert fatigue?

We apply event correlation, noise reduction techniques, and automation to prioritize the alerts that
matter, and to remediate common issues automatically.

Does this help developers too?

Yes. Platform engineering and developer experience improvements reduce friction through standardized
pipelines, self-service, and consistent operational visibility.

Can you integrate with our ITSM and workflows?

Yes. We connect observability signals and automation into workflow tools to improve triage,
ownership, and resolution — creating measurable operational outcomes.

Do you offer managed services for observability and operations?

Yes. We provide ongoing monitoring, administration, tuning, and continuous improvement through
managed services.

## FAQs

How does Arctiq help organizations become ‘AI-ready’?

We establish trusted data foundations, governance, and secure pipelines so AI initiatives can be
developed, deployed, and operated at scale with measurable outcomes.

What is the difference between data governance and data security?

Data security focuses on protection (access controls, encryption, monitoring). Data governance
establishes ownership, policy, lifecycle controls, and accountability so data is trusted and
compliant.

How do you support responsible generative AI (GenAI) adoption?

We combine secure architecture patterns, data controls, and responsible AI governance to reduce
risks like data leakage, prompt injection, and model misuse.

Can you modernize our data platform without disrupting reporting?

Yes. We use phased migration approaches, parallel validation, and governance-first design to
modernize platforms while maintaining continuity.

How do you protect sensitive data across cloud and on-prem environments?

We implement classification, DSPM, DLP, RBAC, encryption, and monitoring across environments to
reduce exposure and support compliance.

Do you help with MLOps and operating models?

Yes. We implement MLOps foundations, CI/CD for models, monitoring, and lifecycle practices so teams
can operate AI reliably over time.

## FAQs

What is Enterprise Service Management (ESM)?

ESM applies service management principles beyond IT — standardizing workflows, visibility, and
accountability across business functions to improve efficiency and experience.

How does ESM improve operational performance?

It reduces manual handoffs, improves routing and ownership, and provides consistent reporting so
teams can meet SLAs and resolve issues faster.

Why Atlassian for ESM and ITSM?

Atlassian platforms provide flexible workflow design, strong collaboration capabilities, and
scalable service management features that can be extended across the enterprise.

How do you ensure adoption and long-term success?

We combine process design, portal experience improvements, training/enablement, and governance
models — supported by ongoing optimization.

Can you migrate from legacy ITSM tools?

Yes. We plan and execute migrations with phased cutovers, data mapping, and validation to maintain
continuity while modernizing workflows.

Do you provide ongoing platform support?

Yes. Our managed services include administration, configuration management, optimization, reporting,
and continuous improvement.

# Service^{IQ} Methodology

##### Transform Your IT Landscape with Proven Strategies for Efficiency, Security, and Growth

Arctiq’s ServiceIQ Methodology is more than just a service delivery framework—it’s a comprehensive
strategy that integrates best practices, deep technical expertise, and a customer-centric approach.

By covering every aspect of the IT lifecycle, from initial assessment to ongoing management, Arctiq
ensures that clients achieve their technology goals efficiently and effectively. The methodology’s
flexible and iterative nature allows for continuous improvement, making it a perfect fit for
organizations navigating the complexities of modern IT landscapes. Whether you are modernizing your
infrastructure, optimizing security, or migrating to the cloud, ServiceIQ is designed to guide your
journey every step of the way.

**Security Assessments**

Arctiq’s InsightIQ Assessments focus on evaluating the current state of your IT environment,
identifying gaps, risks, and areas for improvement. These assessments provide actionable insights
and recommendations to enhance performance, security, and compliance across various technology
domains.

#### **Security Assessment**

Evaluation of your organization's security posture, structured to uncover vulnerabilities, assess
risks, and enhance your defenses. We dive deep into your infrastructure, applications, and policies
to identify gaps and provide actionable recommendations that align with your business objectives.

#### **Vulnerability Assessment**

Conduct scans across various client environments to identify and prioritize vulnerabilities for
remediation.

#### **Penetration Test**

Execute comprehensive testing across black box, web apps, network, endpoints, and insider threats to
identify security weaknesses.

#### **Incident Response Planning and Assessment**

Evaluate readiness for incidents, such as ransomware, through interviews and architectural reviews,
providing actionable recommendations.

#### **GRC Assessment**

Conduct a gap analysis of governance and compliance frameworks, aligning with cyber insurance
requirements using vCISO tooling.

#### **Identity Assessment**

A thorough review of identity sources, privileged access and multi-factor authentication with
practical security enhancement recommendations.

#### **Endpoint and ZTNA Security Assessment**

Analyze current endpoint protection strategies, providing recommendations for threat detection and
response at the endpoint and strategies for least privilege access by user and device.

#### **Patch Management Assessment**

Assess existing patching strategies, identify gaps, and suggest tools and processes to improve patch
frequency and security hygiene.

**Infrastructure Assessments**

Arctiq’s InsightIQ Assessments focus on evaluating the current state of your IT environment,
identifying gaps, risks, and areas for improvement. These assessments provide actionable insights
and recommendations to enhance performance, security, and compliance across various technology
domains.

#### **Network Assessment**

Evaluate the current network infrastructure against industry-leading practices and provides a
findings report with recommendations.

#### **Wireless Assessment & Site Surveys**

Conduct predictive and active/passive wireless surveys to evaluate current deployments and suggest
improvements.

#### **Firewall Best Practices Assessment**

Review firewall policies, traffic patterns, stakeholders and compliance needs, providing
recommendations for policy improvement.

#### **Data Center Assessment**

Assess servers, storage, and software assets, identifying inefficiencies, risks and optimization
opportunities.

#### **Cloud Assessment**

Assess cloud adoption and business requirements, identifying scalability, cost savings, security or
hybrid architecture gaps.

#### **Hypervisor Assessment**

Compare various hypervisor platforms to determine the best fit for virtualized workloads,
considering existing and future requirements.

* **VMware Virtualization Assessment:** Evaluate current VMware install base and recommend ways to
leverage all VCF features, reduce licensing burden, or propose alternative hypervisor platforms.

#### **Microsoft 365 Assessment**

Analyze Microsoft 365 or legacy workforce product deployments, recommending optimizations for
productivity and cost-efficiency.

#### **Active Directory Assessment**

Analyze the structure, configurations, and trust relationships of existing Active Directory
environments.

**Platform Engineering**

Arctiq’s InsightIQ Assessments focus on evaluating the current state of your IT environment,
identifying gaps, risks, and areas for improvement. These assessments provide actionable insights
and recommendations to enhance performance, security, and compliance across various technology
domains.

#### **DevOps Assessment**

Measure the manual labor that goes into the customer SDLC to identify opportunities to automate,
reduce the toil, and improve throughput and drive real financial impact outcomes.

#### **Data & AI Readiness Assessment**

Review data pipelines, governance, and platform readiness to support analytics and AI initiatives.

#### **AI Assessment**

Conduct workshops to assess AI needs, defining use cases and security considerations for AI
deployment.

#### **HashiCorp Boundary and Vault Assessment**

Review the current design and usage of secrets management and PAM solutions, recommending best
practices.

#### **Automation Assessment**

Assess the current Terraform and Ansible deployments, documenting workflows and identifying areas
for improvement.

#### **App Modernization Assessment**

Evaluate readiness for containerization and container orchestration platforms and provide
recommendations on ideal container orchestration platform (on-prem, cloud, cloud).

#### **Observability Assessment**

Document current state observability patterns, investigate sources of signal vs. noise, identify
response gaps and present a roadmap for a business-aligned observability system.

#### **AppSec Assessment**

Evaluate static and dynamic application security testing, secure code analysis and provide findings
and recommendations for better code security and quality.

#### **Observability & AIOps Assessment**

Identify visibility gaps, alert noise, and operational inefficiencies with a roadmap for intelligent
operations.

#### **Enterprise Service Management Assessment**

Evaluate ITSM/ESM processes, workflows, and platforms to improve service delivery and automation.

# Architecture & Design

With a clear understanding of the current state, Arctiq’s DesignIQ Services define the future. This
phase involves designing a robust and scalable architecture that serves as the foundation for the
technology environment. Arctiq’s experts develop detailed blueprints that outline the optimal
configuration of technologies, ensuring the solutions are ready to meet both current and future
demands.

[Diagram - Service IQ - Design IQ]
[ServiceIQ-logo]
[ [logo-Insight IQ-DARK] ][76]
[ [logo-Design IQ-DARK] ][77]
[ [logo-Build IQ-DARK] ][78]

#### **Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Architecture & Design**

##### Create robust, scalable, and secure frameworks for your core infrastructure

Design integrated infrastructure solutions spanning data centers, hybrid cloud, storage, compute,
and backup to ensure high availability, performance, and resilience across your environment.

#### **Networking & Connected Experiences Architecture & Design**

##### Deliver secure, high-performance connectivity and seamless user experiences

Architect modern enterprise network environments across campus, branch, and remote locations with
SD-WAN, SSE, SASE, wireless, and collaboration platforms that enable secure, reliable access from
anywhere.

#### **Cybersecurity Architecture & Design**

##### Fortify your organization’s defenses and ensure comprehensive threat management

Build a resilient security foundation with designs that enable advanced threat detection, rapid
response, and integrated protection across endpoints, networks, cloud, and applications.

#### **Autonomous Operations & Intelligence Architecture & Design**

##### Enable seamless development, modernization, and automation

Architect efficient, scalable platforms that streamline software development, drive self-service,
enhance observability, and leverage AI and data for business innovation.

#### **Data Platforms & AI Architecture & Design**

##### Turn data into a scalable foundation for insight and innovation

Design modern data platforms and AI frameworks that enable data integration, governance, analytics,
and machine learning to support real-time insights and business-driven outcomes.

#### **Enterprise Service Management Architecture & Design**

##### Modernize service delivery and unify operations across the enterprise

Design ITSM and ESM platforms that streamline workflows, automate service delivery, and connect IT,
security, and business functions through integrated, user-centric experiences.

# Implementation & Deployment

## Arctiq’s BuildIQ brings the vision to life.

Our services ensure that the designed solutions are implemented seamlessly, with minimal disruption
to operations. This phase covers everything from system configuration to integration with existing
environments, ensuring a smooth transition to the new state.

[Diagram - Service IQ - Build IQ]
[ServiceIQ-logo]
[ [logo-Design IQ-DARK] ][76]
[ [logo-Build IQ-DARK] ][77]
[ [logo-Shift IQ-DARK] ][78]

#### **Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Implementation & Deployment**

Deliver highly available, secure, and scalable hybrid cloud infrastructure that supports continuous
operations. We implement virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery solutions that
integrate on-premises and cloud environments to ensure critical applications remain accessible,
protected, and optimized for performance, cost efficiency and AI readiness.

#### **Networking & Connected Experiences Implementation & Deployment**

Enable secure, high-performance connectivity that seamlessly connects users, devices, and
applications across any distance and at any scale. We deploy integrated solutions spanning campus,
data center, wireless, and edge environments, combined with SD-WAN, SASE, and zero trust access to
ensure secure, reliable connectivity. We also implement unified communications, contact center, and
physical security solutions—including surveillance and access control—to create cohesive, connected
experiences.

#### **Comprehensive Cybersecurity Solutions Implementation & Deployment**

Deploy and integrate a full spectrum of cybersecurity solutions across your environment, enabling
real-time threat detection, automated response, and identity-first protection. From SIEM and XDR to
IAM and cloud security, we implement and fine-tune platforms that strengthen visibility, reduce
risk, and ensure resilience against evolving threats.

#### **Autonomous Operations & Intelligence Implementation & Deployment**

Operationalize intelligent infrastructure with automation, observability, and workload optimization.
We implement platforms that provide full-stack visibility, automate routine operations, and
dynamically allocate resources to improve efficiency, scalability, and real-time decision-making
across hybrid environments.

#### **Data & AI Implementation & Deployment**

Build and operationalize data platforms that power analytics and AI, including pipeline
implementation, governance tooling, and AI/ML enablement, driving trusted insights and business
value at scale.

#### **Enterprise Service Management Implementation & Deployment**

Implement and migrate enterprise platforms, including workflow automation deployment, portal
development, and system integrations, enabling streamlined operations and connected service
delivery.

# Migrations

ShiftIQ handles the complexities of migrating systems, platforms, or data to new environments.
Whether it’s migrating VMs to a new hypervisor, shifting security logging to a modern event manager,
or pivoting work to an improved pipeline, this phase ensures that transitions are executed with
precision, minimizing downtime and ensuring data integrity.

[Diagram - Service IQ - Shift IQ]
[ServiceIQ-logo]
[ [logo-Build IQ-DARK] ][76]
[ [logo-Shift IQ-DARK] ][77]
[ [logo-Enable IQ-DARK] ][78]
* [Shift IQ-Security] **Security Migrations**
* [Shift IQ-infra] **Cloud and Workload Migrations**
* [Shift IQ-Engineering] **Infrastructure and Network Migrations**

#### **We help you modernize your security infrastructure by migrating SIEM/SOAR platforms, IAM
#### solutions, incident response tools, and surveillance systems to more advanced technologies.**

#### **Event Management**

Migrate legacy SIEM systems to new platforms, including data migration, rule translation and
playbook improvement (e.g. Splunk, Helix, Google SecOps, and Sentinel)

#### **Endpoint Protection**

Transition between Endpoint Detection & Response/Endpoint Protection suites, ensuring seamless
integration, policy transfer, and continuous endpoint protection.

#### **Privileged Access Management**

Migrate and consolidate Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, ensuring secure access
controls, seamless integration, and minimal disruption to critical systems.

#### **Transition your cloud environments and workloads to modern platforms, optimizing for
#### scalability, performance, and flexibility, while ensuring business continuity.**

#### **Migrate to Cloud**

Empower your workloads to thrive in the cloud with a targeted cloud-native approach. Leverage our
expertise in Kubernetes and containerization for a seamless transition. Experience unmatched
performance and scalability, ensuring your cloud infrastructure supports growth and agility.

#### **Migrate from Cloud**

Chart a clear path back to on-premises. When circumstances dictate a strategic shift from the cloud,
Arctiq is prepared to reverse the tide. We handle compliance intricacies and optimize
cost-effectiveness, assuring a smooth reintegration of your infrastructure without the sacrifice of
quality or performance.

#### **Microsoft 365 Migrations**

Migrate from on-premises or other cloud workforce solutions to Microsoft 365, enhancing
collaboration, productivity, and leveraging the latest features and tools.

#### **We manage the migration of critical infrastructure, including data centers, networks,
#### wireless systems, hypervisors, VDI environments, unified communications, and Active Directory,
#### ensuring smooth operations and minimal downtime.**

#### **Network Migrations**

Replace wired, wireless and WAN network infrastructure, including device configuration,
installation, traffic rerouting, and performance optimization.

#### **Firewall Migration**

Migrate or replace firewalls, including rule set transfer, security policy updates, and traffic
cutover.

#### **Active Directory Migration**

Migrate Active Directory to a new forest or domain, including user account transfer, group policy
updates, and domain trust configuration.

#### **Unified Communications Migration**

Migrate communications systems, including call flow design, user migration, and integration with
contact center, paging or other alerting tools.

#### **Data Center Move**

Relocate your physical data center, including equipment migration and business continuity planning.

#### **Data Center Platforms Migration**

Migrate datacenter platforms, including server, storage and data protection system transitions and
hypervisor migrations.

# Adoption and Training

Successful technology adoption requires more than just deployment. EnableIQ focuses on empowering
clients through comprehensive training and adoption services. Arctiq provides hands-on training,
knowledge transfer, and best practices to ensure that teams are fully equipped to leverage new
solutions effectively.

[Diagram - Service IQ - Enable IQ]

#### **Adoption Services**
* **Technical Adoption & Knowledge Transfer:** Empower your teams to fully utilize and manage new
technologies across software, security, infrastructure, cloud, platforms, and applications. We
provide comprehensive guidance to ensure seamless integration, optimal performance, and long-term
value from your IT investments.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot Adoption
* GitHub Copilot Adoption
* **User Adoption:** Help end-users adopt new technologies, such as Microsoft 365 and collaboration
tools, ensuring smooth transitions and maximizing productivity.

#### **Training Services**
* **Operational Training:** Provide training on managing and configuring essential technologies,
including servers, hypervisors, networks, firewalls, and cloud environments.
* **Advanced Training:** Offer specialized training for administrators and developers on advanced
systems, including source code control platforms, HashiCorp, infrastructure as code frameworks,
AppSec suites and AI tools.

# Optimization

The OptimizeIQ phase is dedicated to enhancing and fine-tuning systems post-deployment. Arctiq’s
experts tune, patch and optimize environments to improve performance, security, and efficiency. This
ensures that the solutions remain aligned with evolving business needs and deliver maximum value
over time.

#### **Optimization Services**
* **Network Optimization:** Enhance network performance through configuration updates, firmware
upgrades, and implementing automation and observability best practices.
* **Cloud Optimization:** Optimize cloud resources by improving placement, reducing costs, and
balancing load across regions and availability zones.
* **Platform Optimization:** Streamline software development by enhancing CI/CD pipelines, improving
code quality checks, and automating workflows.

[Optimize IQ-Performance]

#### **Performance Tuning Services**
* **Resource Performance Tuning:** Optimize the allocation and usage of licensing, hypervisor, and
cloud resources to improve cost efficiency and system performance..
* **System Performance Tuning:** Enhance key systems like SIEM/SOAR, IAM, and unified communications
by refining configurations and applying necessary updates for improved functionality.
* **Infrastructure Performance Tuning:** Fine-tune network, wireless, and application environments
to ensure better scalability, reliability, and overall efficiency.

[Optimize IQ-Compliance]

#### **Security & Compliance Optimization**
* **Identity & Access Optimization:** Strengthen security policies and configurations for Active
Directory, IAM, and secrets management systems, ensuring compliance and minimizing risks.
* **Platform Security Optimization:** Enhance security and compliance across developer platforms,
data management, and infrastructure to protect critical assets.

[Optimize IQ-Cost]

#### **Cost Optimization Services**
* **Licensing and Cloud Cost Optimization:** Identify and implement resource changes to reduce
licensing and cloud costs without compromising performance or capabilities, ensuring optimal
return on investment.
* **Infrastructure Cost Optimization:** Streamline infrastructure and operations to eliminate
inefficiencies and reduce ongoing expenses while maintaining system integrity and performance.

[Optimize IQ-Data]

#### **Data & Infrastructure Optimization**
* **Data Optimization:** Refine data architecture and processes to improve efficiency, performance,
and support for business goals.
* **Infrastructure Optimization:** Fine-tune critical infrastructure components to ensure they
operate efficiently, support future growth, and align with financial objectives.

# Security Advisory Services

##### Strategically Prepare. Defend. Recover

Arctiq’s Security Advisory Services help organizations build clarity, confidence, and resilience in
the face of rapidly evolving cyber threats. Our mission is to equip leaders with the insight,
structure, and readiness needed to reduce risk, modernize securely, and respond with precision when
it matters most.

Powered by deep expertise, threat-intelligence partnerships, and methodologies refined through
real-world operations, we guide organizations from intuition-based security to a data-driven,
threat-informed, business-aligned program.

[Request a Consultation][77]
[diagram-SAS-3 (1)]
[Evaluate Risk & Develop Resilience]

## Evaluate Risk & Develop Resilience

### Security Strategy Assessment (SSA)

A strategic imperative for organizations looking to grow securely. The SSA aligns cybersecurity with
business innovation and resilience through a structured workflow - current-state assessment,
collaborative workshops, strategy refinement, and executive-ready presentations - culminating in a
clear, actionable roadmap that fuels long-term security maturity.

### Crown Jewels Identification & Modeling

This program identifies the mission-critical assets that matter most to your organization. Through
business process reviews, impact mapping, classification, and failure mode analysis, Arctiq helps
teams understand residual risk and build resilience plans that prioritize operational continuity.

### Threat Modeling & Attack Path Remediation

By decomposing system architecture and identifying likely attacker pathways, threat modeling
uncovers security gaps before adversaries exploit them. Our structured process delivers tailored
recommendations to strengthen controls, eliminate attack paths, and reduce material risk.

### Flexible Advisory Retainer

A modern, proactive support model offering on-demand access to cybersecurity and IT expertise. This
retainer provides budgeting flexibility, rapid engagement, and cross-functional advisory support,
ensuring you receive the right guidance at the right time, without delaying momentum.

[De-Risk Transformation]

## De-Risk Transformation

### Security Architecture & Blueprinting

Expert guidance to design scalable, modern security frameworks that align with business goals. The
blueprint prioritizes investments, eliminates redundancies, and drives cross-team collaboration,
equipping organizations to build secure-by-design foundations for growth.

### Integrated Cyber Response (iCR) Transformation

A holistic approach that aligns detection, response, and recovery to business impact. iCR identifies
critical services, prioritizes response workflows, and ensures coordinated incident management,
enabling fast, reliable, and repeatable response practices.

### Threat Modeling & Attack Path Remediation

By decomposing system architecture and identifying likely attacker pathways, threat modeling
uncovers security gaps before adversaries exploit them. Our structured process delivers tailored
recommendations to strengthen controls, eliminate attack paths, and reduce material risk.

### AI Enabled Defense

Accelerate detection, improve SOC efficiency, and scale defensive capabilities through AI and
automation. Arctiq’s workflow assesses readiness, defines high-value use cases, and integrates AI
into SOC architecture to enable proactive, intelligence-driven defense.

### Project Management & Master Remediation Program (MRP)

A structured remediation governance model that aligns resources and investments to real threats. MRP
delivers transparent tracking, executive visibility, and accelerated resolution of security
gaps—driving measurable, timely risk reduction across the enterprise.

[Prepare & Strategically Defend]

## Prepare & Strategically Defend

### Organizational Response Confidence Assessment (ORCA)

A readiness assessment designed to evaluate an organization’s ability to detect, respond, and
recover from cyber threats. ORCA examines plans, tooling, visibility, leadership roles, and
cross-team coordination— delivering clear recommendations that strengthen confidence and
decision-making.

### Executive & Technical Tabletop Exercises

Simulated cyber incidents that test an organization’s readiness and decision-making under pressure.
These sessions drive cross-functional collaboration, validate response plans, and reinforce
regulatory confidence, helping reduce the impact of real-world breaches.

### Security Operations Assessment (SOA)

A comprehensive benchmark of SOC people, processes, and technologies against industry standards. The
SOA includes workshops, documentation review, and maturity reporting—culminating in a practical
improvement plan to strengthen detection and response capabilities.

### Cyber Response Program Uplift

Enhances incident response plans, SIEM analytics, and operational readiness. Uplift engagements
refine playbooks, improve detection logic, and leverage purple team validation to ensure defensive
controls operate as intended during real attacks.

### Purple Teaming & Penetration Testing

Collaborative attack simulations that identify vulnerabilities while strengthening detection,
response, and preventive controls. Aligned to business risk, these exercises provide real-time
insights that increase operational resilience and improve SOC performance.

# Arctiq Capital

##### Lower the Cost of Innovation and Improve Financial Flexibility

Technology investments are essential for growth, but they often represent some of the largest
capital expenditures organizations face. Financing strategies that align with technology lifecycles
can help organizations accelerate innovation while maintaining financial predictability.

Arctiq Capital provide flexible financing options designed to help organizations deploy technology
faster while optimizing cash flow and reducing total cost of ownership. By aligning financing with
your infrastructure, software, and services investments, we help you modernize environments, scale
innovation, and achieve greater value from your technology strategy.

##### Through flexible financing structures and a multi-vendor approach, Arctiq enables
##### organizations to implement critical solutions today while maintaining the financial agility
##### needed to support future growth.

production sooner.

investment.

**Greater Technology Flexibility

Arctiq Capital provide tailored financing programs that support the full spectrum of technology

Finance hardware, software, and services through structured programs that align with your

payment plans, and lifecycle-aligned financing.

Modernize infrastructure more frequently by aligning financing terms with technology refresh cycles.

# Managed^{IQ} Services Overview

##### Run Your Technology Operations with Confidence

Modern technology environments demand constant attention. Hybrid infrastructure, distributed
networks, cloud platforms, and evolving cyber threats require continuous monitoring, expert
management, and rapid response.

##### Arctiq’s ManagedIQ Services provide the operational expertise, automation, and security
##### oversight organizations need to run complex environments with confidence.
#####
#####
##### Arctiq delivers fully managed services that monitor, manage, and optimize critical technology
##### systems 24x7x365, delivered from Security Operations Centers & Network Operations Centers. Our
##### experts extend your internal teams with specialized operational support across infrastructure,
##### networking, and cybersecurity to ensure systems remain resilient, secure, and aligned with
##### business objectives. Through proactive monitoring, advanced automation, and deep technical
##### expertise, Arctiq’s ManagedIQ Services allow organizations to reduce operational complexity
##### while improving performance, security, and reliability.

[Request a Consultation][77]

[Service IQ-main]

## Managed^{IQ}

#### Why Organizations Choose ManagedIQ

Many organizations face growing challenges in maintaining modern IT environments:
* Limited internal resources to manage complex infrastructure
* Increasing security threats and compliance requirements
* Expanding hybrid cloud and multi-platform architectures
* Operational silos across infrastructure, networking, and security

Arctiq brings these disciplines together through an integrated managed services model that provides
continuous visibility, operational support, and expert guidance.

### **With Arctiq’s ManagedIQ Services, organizations can:**

###### Improve system uptime and operational resilience

###### Strengthen cybersecurity posture and response capabilities

###### Reduce internal operational burden

###### Gain continuous monitoring and reporting

###### Scale operations without increasing staffing requirements

[core-values]

## Integrated Managed Services Across the Enterprise

Arctiq provides managed services across core technology domains, supported by 24x7x365 SOC and NOC
capabilities that deliver continuous monitoring, rapid response, and expert operational management
to ensure security, performance, and availability.

### Cybersecurity Managed Services

Protect critical systems and data with advanced threat detection, vulnerability management, and
security program leadership.

**Capabilities include:**
* Managed Extended Detection and Response (MXDR)
* Managed SIEM Operations
* Vulnerability and Attack Surface Management
* Patch Management as a Service
* Virtual CISO (vCISO) services

[Read More][78]

### Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Managed Services

Ensure infrastructure, endpoints, data protection, and recovery environments remain secure,
resilient, and operational.

**Capabilities include:**
* Managed Infrastructure
* Backup as a Service and Managed Backup
* Managed Desktop Monitoring and Management
* Managed Disaster Recovery Planning and Execution
* Disaster Recovery as a Service

[Read More][79]

### Networking & Connected Experiences Managed Services

Maintain reliable connectivity and high-performance networking environments with proactive
monitoring and operational management.

**Capabilities include:**
* Network Monitoring
* Fully Managed Networking
* Managed Carrier Services and Connectivity Management

[Read More][80]

### Managed SmartOps

Arctiq’s Managed SmartOps is a bundled offering that covers end-to-end operational management to
keep systems stable, secure, and optimized.

**Capabilities include:**
* Full-stack visibility with managed alerts
* Configuration, patching, and lifecycle management
* Health reporting with a single owner for outcomes

[Read More][81]

## Continuous Operations. Continuous Improvement.

Arctiq’s ManagedIQ Services are designed to deliver more than reactive support. Our services focus
on proactive operations and continuous improvement.

Through centralized monitoring, alert aggregation, and automation platforms, Arctiq provides
real-time visibility into system health and security posture while continuously optimizing
performance and resilience.

Organizations gain the advantage of a dedicated team of engineers, security analysts, and operations

# Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Managed Services

##### Resilient Infrastructure Operations for the Hybrid Enterprise

Modern infrastructure environments span data centers, cloud platforms, virtualized workloads, and
distributed endpoints. Managing these environments requires continuous monitoring, proactive
maintenance, and reliable recovery capabilities.

Arctiq’s Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure ManagedIQ Services ensure critical infrastructure systems
remain secure, optimized, and highly available.

Through proactive monitoring, automated maintenance, and operational support, our experts help
organizations maintain resilient infrastructure environments while reducing operational complexity.

[Request a Consultation][77]

## Managed Infrastructure

Arctiq manages critical on-prem or cloud-based infrastructure on behalf of clients, providing
operational oversight and ongoing system maintenance.

**Services include:**
* Infrastructure monitoring and alert response
* Patching and configuration management
* Moves, adds, and changes
* Operational health monitoring and reporting

## Backup as a Service and Managed Backup

Your data is only as valuable as your ability to recover it. Arctiq provides full lifecycle
management of client backup and data protection environments, including policy governance, job
monitoring, recovery validation, and ongoing operational support, across platforms including
Commvault, Zerto, Infinidat, and Cloudian.

For organizations looking to fully offload backup infrastructure, our Backup as a Service (BaaS)
offering delivers a complete, air-gapped solution on an OpEx model with secure recovery targets
available across all major cloud providers and our Denver and Atlanta data centers.

** Capabilities include: **
* Backup management and monitoring
* Data replication and storage management
* Recovery planning and testing
* Secure off-site storage with air-gapped recovery options
* OpEx-based Backup as a Service (BaaS)

## Managed Desktop Operations

Maintain endpoint health and operational visibility across distributed user environments.

**Services include:**
* Remote monitoring and management of endpoints
* Patch management and updates
* Performance monitoring and alerting
* Endpoint operational support

## Disaster Recovery as a Service and Managed Disaster Recovery

When a disaster hits, the plan you made six months ago is the only thing standing between you and
chaos. Arctiq manages the full DR lifecycle on your behalf, from architecture and planning through
failover execution and post-recovery validation, so your team isn't figuring it out in the middle of
an outage.

We work across your environment ahead of time to ensure recovery procedures are tested, documented,
and ready to execute. When an event occurs, our engineers lead the response.

For organizations that want to fully offload their recovery infrastructure, our DR as a Service
(DRaaS) offering provides managed failover targets hosted in our Denver and Atlanta data centers,
available on an OpEx model.

** Capabilities include:**
* DR planning and architecture support
* Managed failover execution during recovery events
* Validation of application and infrastructure functionality post-recovery
* Rollback assistance following recovery operations
* Hosted DR targets via DR as a Service (DRaaS)

# Networking & Connected Experiences Managed Services

##### Reliable Connectivity and Network Performance

Modern organizations depend on highly available, high-performance networks to support digital
services, distributed workforces, and cloud applications.

Arctiq’s Networking & Connected Experiences ManagedIQ Services provide continuous monitoring,
operational support, and expert network management to ensure reliable connectivity and optimal
performance.

Our teams operate as an extension of your network operations organization, proactively identifying
issues, resolving incidents, and optimizing network environments.

[Request a Consultation][77]

## Network Monitoring

Arctiq’s NOC provides centralized monitoring and response for networking infrastructure.

**Services include:**
* Continuous network monitoring
* Alert analysis and response
* Incident triage and escalation
* Performance monitoring and reporting

## Managed Network Services

Arctiq provides full operational management of networking infrastructure.

**Capabilities include:**
* Network device monitoring and management
* Configuration changes and operational updates
* Patching and lifecycle maintenance
* Incident response and troubleshooting

## Managed Carrier Services and Transport

Simplify carrier management by consolidating connectivity services under a single operational model.

**Arctiq manages:**
* Internet connectivity
* MPLS networks
* SIP and voice transport
* Wireline carrier services

**Services include:**
* Carrier service management
* Moves, adds, and changes
* Connectivity monitoring and issue resolution
* Vendor coordination and escalation management

# Cybersecurity Managed Services

##### Continuous Security Operations for Modern Threat Environments

Cyber threats are evolving rapidly, and organizations require continuous monitoring, rapid response,
and proactive exposure management to stay protected.

Arctiq’s Cybersecurity ManagedIQ Services deliver advanced detection, response, and security program
management through our integrated security operations platform.

##### Our experts provide 24x7 security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and
##### strategic guidance to help organizations strengthen their security posture and reduce risk.

[Request a Consultation][77]

## Managed Extended Detection and Response (MXDR)

MXDR delivers integrated security monitoring and response across endpoints, identity platforms,
cloud environments, and network infrastructure.

**Capabilities include:**
* Threat detection and alert monitoring
* Incident investigation and response
* Integration across identity, endpoint, and email security platforms
* Continuous security posture monitoring

## Managed SIEM Operations

Arctiq manages SIEM platforms on behalf of clients to ensure optimized monitoring and threat
detection.

**Services include:**
* SIEM platform management
* Rule tuning and alert optimization
* Security monitoring and investigation
* Integration with security tools and telemetry sources

**Supported Platforms**
* Google Security Operations
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Cisco Splunk

## Vulnerability and Attack Surface Management

Identify and remediate vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them.

**Capabilities include:**
* Continuous vulnerability scanning
* External attack surface monitoring
* Exposure analysis and risk prioritization
* Remediation guidance and validation

## Patch Management as a Service

Ensure systems remain protected through consistent patch management.

**Services include:**
* Automated patch deployment
* Endpoint and server patch management
* Compliance reporting and validation

## Virtual CISO (vCISO)

Provide executive-level security leadership without requiring a full-time internal CISO.

**Services include:**
* Security strategy development
* Governance and risk management
* Security program oversight
* Compliance support and reporting

# Managed SmartOps

##### Comprehensive Operations Management, Simplified

Your team shouldn't have to think about which monitoring team handles which alert. Managed SmartOps
bundles proactive monitoring, operational management, and expert support across your full
environment into a single engagement. You get complete coverage without the overhead of managing
multiple service relationships.

[Request a Consultation][77]

**AVAILABLE IN TWO CONFIGURATIONS TO MATCH YOUR ENVIRONMENT:**

#### Managed SmartOps: **User**

Covers your endpoint and user environment, including desktop management, endpoint monitoring, patch
management, and user-side operational support. One team, one engagement, complete user stack
coverage.

#### Managed SmartOps: **Infrastructure**

Covers your server, data center, and hybrid infrastructure environment, including infrastructure
monitoring, configuration management, patching, and backup operations. Everything your
infrastructure team needs to hand off, in one place.

**Capabilities include:**
* Proactive monitoring and alert management across the full stack
* Configuration management and operational changes
* Patch management and lifecycle maintenance
* Performance monitoring and health reporting
* Single point of accountability for operational outcomes

#### Bundled Managed Services

##### **Complete Outcomes Across Infrastructure, Operations, and Security**

Most organizations don't need a different team for every layer of their environment. They need
outcomes. Arctiq's bundled managed service offerings bring infrastructure operations, user
environment management, and security capabilities together into single, integrated engagements so
you get complete coverage without the complexity of managing multiple service relationships.
